principal.employee_id AND self_employee.company_id = target_company.company_id ) ) ) ORDER BY data_scope.scope_type, data_scope.scope_id

SELECT projection.attendance_report_projection_id AS projection_id, projection.company_id, projection.projection_version, projection.period_state, projection.source_versions_json, projection.data_as_of FROM attendance_report_projection projection WHERE projection.period_start = #{periodStart} AND projection.period_end_exclusive = #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( #{companyId} IS NULL OR projection.company_id = #{companyId} ) AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND projection.formula_catalog_version = 'FULL_CALCULATION_OVERTIME_CLASSIFICATION_V2' AND projection.published_at <= #{authorizationTime} AND AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_report_projection newer_projection WHERE newer_projection.company_id = projection.company_id AND newer_projection.period_start = #{periodStart} AND newer_projection.period_end_exclusive = #{periodEndExclusive} AND newer_projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND newer_projection.formula_catalog_version = 'FULL_CALCULATION_OVERTIME_CLASSIFICATION_V2' AND newer_projection.published_at <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( newer_projection.published_at > projection.published_at OR ( newer_projection.published_at = projection.published_at AND newer_projection.attendance_report_projection_id > projection.attendance_report_projection_id ) ) ) ORDER BY projection.company_id, projection.published_at DESC, projection.attendance_report_projection_id DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT DISTINCT data_scope.scope_id, data_scope.scope_type, data_scope.company_id, data_scope.organization_id, data_scope.include_descendants, principal.employee_id AS principal_employee_id FROM attendance_report_projection projection JOIN auth_principal principal ON principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment role_assignment ON role_assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = role_assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capabilityCode} AND capability.capability_code IN ( 'ATTENDANCE_REPORT:READ', 'ATTENDANCE_REPORT:EXPORT_CREATE', 'ATTENDANCE_REPORT:EXPORT_DOWNLOAD' ) JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = role_assignment.data_scope_id WHERE projection.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND role_assignment.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( role_assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR role_assignment.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{authorizationTime} ) AND ( ( data_scope.scope_type = 'COMPANY' AND data_scope.company_id = projection.company_id ) OR ( data_scope.scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_identity scoped_organization JOIN organization_current_projection scoped_projection ON scoped_projection.organization_id = scoped_organization.organization_id JOIN organization_version scoped_version ON scoped_version.organization_version_id = scoped_projection.current_version_id AND scoped_version.organization_id = scoped_organization.organization_id WHERE scoped_organization.organization_id = data_scope.organization_id AND scoped_organization.company_id = projection.company_id AND scoped_organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' AND scoped_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND scoped_version.effective_from <= #{authorizationTime} AND ( scoped_version.effective_to IS NULL OR scoped_version.effective_to > #{authorizationTime} ) ) ) OR ( data_scope.scope_type = 'SELF' AND principal.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM employee self_employee WHERE self_employee.employee_id = principal.employee_id AND self_employee.company_id = projection.company_id ) ) ) ORDER BY data_scope.scope_type, data_scope.scope_id

SELECT employee_month.company_id, employee_month.organization_id, SUM(employee_month.actual_attendance_days) AS actual_attendance_days, SUM(employee_month.scheduled_attendance_days) AS scheduled_attendance_days, SUM(employee_month.sick_leave_days) AS sick_leave_days, CAST( ROUND( CAST(SUM(employee_month.actual_attendance_days) AS DECIMAL(19, 4)) * 100 / NULLIF( SUM(employee_month.scheduled_attendance_days), 0 ), 2 ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2) ) AS attendance_rate FROM ( SELECT fact.company_id, fact.organization_id, fact.employee_id, SUM(fact.actual_attendance_days) AS actual_attendance_days, SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days) AS scheduled_attendance_days, SUM(CASE WHEN fact.leave_type = 'SICK' THEN fact.scheduled_attendance_days ELSE 0 END) AS sick_leave_days FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE projection.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) GROUP BY fact.company_id, fact.organization_id, fact.employee_id HAVING SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days) > 0 ) employee_month GROUP BY employee_month.company_id, employee_month.organization_id ORDER BY employee_month.organization_id

SELECT fact.company_id, fact.employee_id, fact.organization_id, SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days) AS sick_leave_days FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id WHERE projection.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.leave_type = 'SICK' AND AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND (#{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND (#{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId}) GROUP BY fact.company_id, fact.employee_id, fact.organization_id ORDER BY fact.organization_id, fact.employee_id

SELECT fact.company_id, fact.employee_id, MAX(employee_version.employee_number) AS employee_number, MAX(employee_version.display_name) AS employee_name, fact.organization_id, MAX(organization_version.name) AS organization_name, MIN(fact.business_date) AS period_start, MAX(fact.business_date) AS period_end, SUM(fact.actual_attendance_days) AS actual_attendance_days, SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days) AS scheduled_attendance_days, CASE WHEN SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( ROUND( CAST(SUM(fact.actual_attendance_days) AS DECIMAL(19, 4)) * 100 / SUM(fact.scheduled_attendance_days), 2 ) AS DECIMAL(10, 2) ) END AS attendance_rate FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.assignment_id = fact.employment_period_id AND employment.employee_id = fact.employee_id AND employment.organization_id = fact.organization_id AND DATE(employment.effective_from) <= fact.business_date AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > fact.business_date ) JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = fact.employee_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = fact.organization_id WHERE projection.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) AND ( #{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) GROUP BY fact.company_id, fact.employee_id, fact.employment_period_id, fact.organization_id ORDER BY employee_number, period_start, fact.organization_id

SELECT fact.attendance_report_daily_fact_id AS fact_id, fact.company_id, fact.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, fact.organization_id, fact.organization_version_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, fact.business_date, fact.day_type, fact.shift_label, fact.scheduled_minutes, fact.confirmed_scheduled_work_minutes, fact.recognized_overtime_minutes, fact.paid_overtime_minutes, fact.compensatory_overtime_minutes, fact.voluntary_overtime_minutes, fact.total_overtime_minutes, fact.leave_or_time_off_minutes, fact.leave_type, fact.absence_minutes, fact.actual_work_minutes, fact.scheduled_attendance_days, fact.actual_attendance_days, fact.late_minutes, fact.penalized_late_minutes, fact.early_departure_minutes, fact.missing_punch_count, fact.first_punch_at, fact.last_punch_at, fact.calculation_version_id, fact.result_digest FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = fact.employee_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = fact.organization_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) AND ( #{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) ORDER BY fact.business_date, employee_version.employee_number, fact.attendance_report_daily_fact_id

SELECT fact.oa_attendance_document_id AS document_id, fact.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, fact.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, fact.document_type, fact.leave_type_code AS leave_type, COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) AS start_at, CASE WHEN fact.interval_end IS NOT NULL THEN fact.interval_end ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, 1, fact.point_instant) END AS end_exclusive, fact.recognized_minutes, fact.source_status, fact.source_version FROM attendance_report_oa_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = fact.employee_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = fact.organization_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) < #{periodEndExclusiveAt} AND COALESCE( fact.interval_end, TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, 1, fact.point_instant) ) > #{periodStartAt} AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) AND ( #{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) ORDER BY start_at, employee_version.employee_number, fact.attendance_report_oa_fact_id

SELECT fact.exception_case_id AS case_id, fact.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, fact.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, fact.business_date, fact.exception_type, fact.severity, fact.state, fact.exception_minutes AS minutes, fact.safe_evidence_summary, fact.calculation_version_id FROM attendance_report_exception_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = fact.employee_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = fact.organization_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) AND ( #{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR fact.state = #{status}) ORDER BY fact.business_date, employee_version.employee_number, fact.exception_case_id

SELECT fact.account_id, fact.employee_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, fact.organization_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, fact.account_type, fact.opening_hours, fact.granted_hours, fact.overtime_credit_hours, fact.manual_increase_hours, fact.used_hours, fact.expired_hours, fact.returned_hours, fact.manual_deduction_hours, fact.ledger_version FROM attendance_report_time_account_fact fact JOIN attendance_report_projection projection ON projection.attendance_report_projection_id = fact.attendance_report_projection_id AND projection.company_id = fact.company_id JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_version_id = fact.employee_version_id AND employee_version.employee_id = fact.employee_id JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_version_id = fact.organization_version_id AND organization_version.organization_id = fact.organization_id WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = #{projectionId} AND fact.company_id = #{companyId} AND AND ( #{organizationId} IS NULL OR fact.organization_id = #{organizationId} ) AND ( #{employeeId} IS NULL OR fact.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) ORDER BY employee_version.employee_number, fact.account_type, fact.account_id
